# parity-fuzz --mode typeset baseline: normalized signatures of KNOWN gaps.
# A divergence whose signature is here is allowed; a NEW one fails CI.
# Regenerate: parity-fuzz --mode typeset --count N --verify 3  (copy NEW-signature lines).
#
# KNOWN GAP — `typeset -l`/`-u` case fold applied at ASSIGNMENT, not on READ
# (docs/BUGS.md #1019). C stores the ORIGINAL value and folds on read
# (getstrvalue, c:params.c:2505) / export (copyenvstr, c:5439), so `typeset +l`
# re-exposes the original case. zshrs folds eagerly at assignment and loses it,
# so removing the flag shows the folded value. The plain `[$v]` read matches
# (both folded). The `_` arm now generates the `typeset -p` + flag-removal forms
# that surface this; the four signatures below are the KNOWN divergence and are
# expected until #1019 is fixed (a multi-path change — route PM_LOWER/PM_UPPER
# scalars through getstrvalue and drop the eager assignment fold). When fixed,
# delete these four lines.
typeset +l v0; print -r -- "orig=[$v0]"
typeset +l W; print -r -- "orig=[$W]"
typeset +u v0; print -r -- "orig=[$v0]"
typeset +u W; print -r -- "orig=[$W]"
